latin: Opinio quae Auicennae ascribitur, quod illud unum, quod cum ente conuertitur sit unum quod est principium numeri, et ita consequenter quod unaquaeque res sit una per intentionem additam essentiae suae, si non est necessario uera, est tamen probabilis et defendetur a me.
translation: The view that is assigned to Avicenna, namely that the one which is interchangeable with being is the one that begins number, and therefore that every single thing is one because of an intention superadded to its essence, may not be necessarily true, yet it is probable, and I will uphold it.
